topic: Write a Journal Entry about Living in Space(写一篇太空生活日记)
title_en: A Day on Board the Spacecraft
genre: 日记 / 记叙(journal entry：describe what you did on board + how you felt)
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修第四册 Unit 6 Developing ideas Writing：imagine you have spent 24 hours on board a spacecraft and write a journal entry(你在航天器上度过24小时,写一篇日记:做了什么、感受如何、最喜欢/最不喜欢什么)。
prompt_cn: 假设你是一名航天员,在航天器上度过了第一天的24小时。请用英语写一篇约100词的日记,内容包括:① 你在航天器上做了哪些事(如失重中睡觉、锻炼、吃饭等);② 你的感受;③ 你最喜欢和最不喜欢的部分。注意:适当用上情态动词(如 have to / must / can / could),让推测与必要表达自然。
prompt_en: Suppose you are an astronaut who has spent the first 24 hours on board a spacecraft. Write a journal entry (about 100 words) including: 1) what you did on board (e.g. sleeping, exercising and eating in zero gravity); 2) how you felt; 3) the part you enjoyed most and the part you enjoyed least. Try to use modal verbs (have to, must, can, could) naturally.
points: 做了什么(I had to strap myself in to sleep / I must exercise every day)
感受(At first everything felt strange, but it was awesome)
最喜欢 / 最不喜欢(What I enjoyed most was … The hardest part was …)
适当使用情态动词表必要与能力
model_essay: Day 1 on board. What an awesome day it has been! In this world without gravity, there is no up or down, so I had to strap myself into a sleeping bag just to rest safely. In the morning I must have spent an hour cleaning the cabin, because dust floats everywhere. We have to exercise every day, or our muscles will grow weak, so I worked hard on the machine. Eating was the strangest part: I could not use ordinary salt, since it would simply float away. What I enjoyed most was looking down at the blue Earth through the window. The hardest part was getting used to floating, but I am sure I can do better tomorrow.
model_translation: 在航天器上的第一天。今天真是太棒了!在这个没有重力的世界里,没有上下之分,所以我得把自己绑进睡袋才能安全休息。早上我大概花了一个小时打扫舱室,因为灰尘到处乱飘。我们必须每天锻炼,否则肌肉会变弱,所以我在机器上努力锻炼。吃饭最奇怪:我没法用普通的盐,因为它会直接飘走。我最喜欢的是透过舷窗俯瞰蓝色的地球。最难的是适应漂浮,但我相信明天会做得更好。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:做了什么 / 感受 / 最喜欢与最不喜欢
按日记顺序展开、衔接自然、人称时态一致
情态动词(have to/must/can/could)运用得当、词汇句型准确多样、语法基本无误

required_structure: 开头点明 Day 1 on board + 总体感受
做了什么 I had to strap myself in to sleep / We have to exercise every day
细节感受 Eating was the strangest part …
结尾 最喜欢/最不喜欢 + 展望 I am sure I can do better tomorrow
key_expressions: In this world without gravity, there is no up or down.
I had to strap myself into a sleeping bag just to rest safely.
We have to exercise every day, or our muscles will grow weak.
What I enjoyed most was looking down at the blue Earth.

high_sentences: In this world without gravity, there is no up or down.
We have to exercise every day, or our muscles will grow weak.
I could not use ordinary salt, since it would simply float away.
The hardest part was getting used to floating, but I can do better tomorrow.

error_pairs.wrong: I must to exercise every day.
error_pairs.note: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形,不加 to。

error_pairs.wrong: I had to strapped myself in.
error_pairs.correct: I had to strap myself in.
error_pairs.note: have to 后接动词原形 strap。

error_pairs.wrong: The dust floats everywhere, so I must cleaned the cabin.
error_pairs.correct: The dust floats everywhere, so I had to clean the cabin.
error_pairs.note: 表过去的必要用 had to + 原形,不用 must + 过去式。

paragraph_template:
【太空生活日记结构】
开头 Day 1 on board. What an awesome day!
做了什么 I had to … / We have to … / I must …
细节感受 The strangest part was …
结尾 What I enjoyed most was … The hardest part was … I can do better tomorrow.
